label: Glucose
description: Glucose is the candidate carbon-source input. It can enter C3, C2, and C1 carbon-flow routes through isomerization, cleavage, and oxidation steps.
descriptionZh: 葡萄糖是候选碳源输入，可经异构化、裂解和氧化路径进入 C3/C2/C1 碳流网络。
risks: Direct carbon contribution to formate still needs isotope tracing.
Parallel side reactions can consume glucose carbon.
risksZh: 对甲酸碳源的直接贡献仍需同位素追踪确认。
并行副反应可能消耗葡萄糖碳。

label: Fructose
description: Fructose connects glucose isomerization to retro-aldol cleavage and dehydration side reactions.
descriptionZh: 果糖连接葡萄糖异构化、retro-aldol 裂解和脱水副反应。
risks: Dehydration to HMF/Humins can compete with formate formation.
risksZh: 脱水生成 HMF/Humins 会与甲酸生成竞争。

label: HCO3- / CO2
description: Bicarbonate / carbon dioxide may participate in formate formation or buffer the local reaction environment.
descriptionZh: 碳酸氢根 / 二氧化碳可能参与甲酸盐生成，或调节局部反应环境。
risks: Carbon contribution requires NaH13CO3 isotope tracing.
risksZh: 碳源贡献需要 NaH¹³CO₃ 同位素追踪验证。

label: C3 intermediate
description: C3 intermediates connect glucose/fructose cleavage to C2/C1 formation and organic-acid by-product routes.
descriptionZh: C3 中间体连接葡萄糖/果糖裂解、C2/C1 生成和有机酸副产物路径，是碳流网络中的关键分岔节点。
risks: Can enter both target and by-product pathways.
risksZh: 中间体来源需要时间序列数据确认。
可能同时进入甲酸路径和有机酸副产物路径。

label: C2 intermediate
description: C2 intermediates can contribute to formate formation or divert carbon into glycolic, acetic, or oxalic acid products.
descriptionZh: C2 中间体可贡献甲酸生成，也可能将碳流分流到乙醇酸、乙酸或草酸等副产物。
risks: C2 accumulation may reduce formate selectivity.
risksZh: C2 累积可能降低甲酸选择性。

label: C1 intermediate
description: C1 intermediate represents formaldehyde-like carbon flow toward formate.
descriptionZh: C1 中间体表示类甲醛碳流进入甲酸/甲酸盐路径。
risks: C3 to C1 cleavage remains a key experimental bottleneck.
risksZh: C3 到 C1 的裂解仍是关键实验瓶颈。

label: Formate
description: Formate is the target C1 product that may arise from C1 oxidation, C2/C3 cleavage, or HCO3- / CO2 participation.
descriptionZh: 甲酸 / 甲酸盐是目标 C1 产物，可由 C1 氧化、C2/C3 裂解或 HCO₃⁻ / CO₂ 参与路径生成。
risks: Carbon source must be separated by isotope tracing and carbon balance.
risksZh: 碳源需要通过同位素追踪与碳平衡区分。

label: Organic acid product pool
description: The organic-acid product pool includes lactic, acetic, glycolic, and oxalic acid branches that compete with formate selectivity.
descriptionZh: 有机酸副产物池包括乳酸、乙酸、乙醇酸和草酸等分支，会与甲酸选择性竞争。
risks: By-product distribution is required to estimate selectivity loss.
risksZh: 需要副产物分布来估计选择性损失。

label: HMF / Humins
description: HMF / Humins represents dehydration and condensation side pathways that can consume sugar carbon.
descriptionZh: HMF / 腐殖质代表糖脱水与缩合副路径，可能消耗糖碳。
risks: This branch reduces target formate selectivity and carbon balance.
risksZh: 该分支降低甲酸选择性和碳平衡。

label: pH / buffer / ionic environment
labelZh: pH / 缓冲 / 离子环境
description: pH, dissolved oxygen, ionic strength, and coordination environment can change pathway preference.
descriptionZh: pH、溶氧、离子强度和配位环境可能改变路径偏好。
risks: Environmental variables are currently represented as regulation factors, not kinetic measurements.
risksZh: 环境变量当前表示为调控因素，不是动力学测量。
